headline: Sakuma Exports schedules Extraordinary General Meeting for November 2026
hook: November EGM scheduled by Sakuma Exports
summary: Sakuma Exports Limited has issued a formal notice to the stock exchanges regarding an upcoming Extraordinary General Meeting. The meeting is scheduled to take place on November 21, 2026.
